about_the_game:
The war with the Reds rages on.

Building on the foundation laid by Mecha Knights: Nightmare, the sequel expands and refines the experience with improved movement, deeper customization, and a continuation of Ethan’s story. Witness the next chapter of humanity’s desperate war against the Reds in an intense single-player campaign as mankind struggles to stop the monstrous onslaught and uncover the truth behind their origins.

Dynamic Battles

Unleash destruction in large-scale battles packed with hordes of enemies, destructible environments, and expanded tactical mobility.

  • Buildings can be leveled by your own weapons or massive enemies rampaging through the battlefield.

  • Use flight to flank, snipe high-priority targets, or quickly escape danger.

  • Switch hand weapons between melee and ranged modes to crush enemies up close or at a distance.

Deep Customization

Assemble and fine-tune your mech to match your combat style.

  • Build your mech choosing head, torso, arms, legs, and tail booster.

  • Equip up to two hand weapons, two back weapons, and two melee weapons to create your ideal war machine for any mission.

  • Choose from a wide range of equipment for four hardpoints on the shoulders and legs - from Active Protection Systems to Mine Layers.

  • Equip powerful Battlegroup support abilities like missile strikes, supply drops, or air support to shift the tide of battle.

Create moving fortresses with tank legs and massive cannons, mobile aerial builds for high-speed strikes, or anything in between.

MKN2

Made by the same solo developer behind Mecha Knights: Nightmare, now with more development time, resources, experience, and support behind it.

It’s still a passion project, but more ambitious, more refined, shaped by everything learned along the way, and built with player feedback in mind.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains strong language, graphic violence and gore, mildly suggestive imagery in the form of stylized nose-art decals, and dialogue or references that imply romantic or sexual intimacy.
